messages:
maria_cs: Quick flag — Beta cohort customer 'NovaRetail' dropped ~70% API usage starting last Tue. No spikes in errors, just traffic fell off.
aj_sales: Oof. Any signal they switched vendors?
leo_csm: They ran a small pilot with ShopFlux last month, sales mentioned. No formal procurement yet.
pm_cheng: Do we have any recent enablement or training logs for them?
maria_cs: Last enablement session was 2/8, high engagement. Post-session follow-ups went quiet.
leo_csm: Stakeholder update: original champion (Sam) moved to strategy; new contact is Kelly in Ops — unresponsive so far.
aj_sales: @leo_csm can you share the pilot details? Are they testing features we don't support?
leo_csm: ShopFlux pilot was focused on labeled-product reranking + multimodal SKU mapping — some overlap with our rerank API.
pm_cheng: Could be price or feature fit. Recommend quick health play: 1) outreach to Kelly 2) offer 1-week free rerank tuning 3) propose ROI runbook.
mar ia_cs: typo in previous, meant to say "maria_cs" :)
leo_csm: Sent an email to Kelly and cc'd procurement yesterday; no reply. I can do a soft-touch convo this week.
aj_sales: Also flagged account as renewal watch — contract renews in 55 days. Please add to churn queue.
deploy-bot: [automated] last successful onboarding job for NovaRetail: 2024-10-18 09:12UTC. No new deploys in 21 days.
maria_cs: Next steps: @leo_csm reach out to Kelly (phone + email). @aj_sales can you prepare a 1-pager comparing our rerank latency/cost vs ShopFlux? I can offer the free tuning.
pm_cheng: I'll join the call if we get a slot — can present quick perf numbers and suggest canary.
aj_sales: On it. Draft 1-pager by EOD.
leo_csm: I'll ping Kelly tomorrow and update thread. If no response, propose an exec intro to Sam.
maria_cs: Thanks — logging action items into the renewal playbook. Adding internal tag: "quiet-usage + competitor-pilot" :eyes: 
aj_sales: Thx team. If we see any spike downward in the next 48h, escalate to SRE for tracing but so far metrics look clean.
deploy-bot: [alert] prefix cache hit rate unchanged; no errors.
leo_csm: Update — Kelly replied, wants a 30-min call next Tue. Putting calendar hold and prepping ROI brief.
maria_cs: Great. Marking this thread as monitored.
